BinOpKind.doc: Binary operator discriminator. All operands are read from registers; destination is a register. NULL propagation is NULL-in-NULL-out for every case except Eq/Ne under IS/IS NOT form (not in this enum — see UnaryOpKind::IsNull).

UnaryOpKind.doc: Unary operator discriminator. IsNull/NotNull return Integer(0/1), never Null — they are explicit NULL tests.

CastKind.doc: CAST target type. Integer/Real/Text correspond to SQLite's NUMERIC/REAL/TEXT affinity coercions. Blob cast is handled as Text here (SQLite treats it that way for numeric-to-blob; blob-to-blob is no-op).

ScalarKind.doc: Scalar function discriminator. Each kind's argument arity and NULL semantics are pinned in master.md §Scalar functions. Dispatch is on this enum inside OpcodeExpr::Scalar's handler.

OpcodeExpr.doc: Expression evaluation opcodes. BinOp collapses 18 binary ops into one variant keyed on BinOpKind; UnaryOp collapses 5 unary ops on UnaryOpKind. Like/Glob/Cast/Collate/Scalar/CastRealToText are per-op variants where the operand shape differs enough to warrant it.

BinOp.doc: Apply kind to regs[lhs] and regs[rhs]; store in regs[dest_reg]. Per-kind semantics pinned in master.md.

UnaryOp.doc: Apply kind to regs[src]; store in regs[dest_reg].

Cast.doc: Coerce regs[src] to kind; store in regs[dest_reg]. NULL input → NULL output (no coercion attempted on NULL).

Like.doc: SQL LIKE: case-insensitive (ASCII fold), % matches zero-or-more, _ matches exactly-one. esc (if Some) names the register holding a single-char Text acting as escape. NULL in any input → NULL output.

Glob.doc: Unix-glob: case-sensitive, * matches zero-or-more, ? matches exactly-one, [abc] character class. NULL in any input → NULL output.

Collate.doc: Tag regs[src] with a collation name for subsequent comparison ops. Runtime representation: returns the value unchanged with a collation annotation in the out-of-band comparison path (target-specific). v2 recognizes 'BINARY' (default), 'NOCASE', 'RTRIM'; unknown collation Halts(Error(OpcodeIllegal)). The collation string is a borrowed slice over the Program source and does not outlive it.

Scalar.doc: Dispatch a scalar function. Args are read from regs[args[0..]]; result written to regs[dest_reg]. Arity checking is a compiler responsibility; runtime assumes well-formed. Per-kind semantics in master.md.

CastRealToText.doc: Specialized Real-to-Text cast using SQLite's %!.15g Ryu-clone format. Distinct from Cast{Text} because SQLite's general text coercion uses different formatting for Real; this opcode pins the exact byte-identical output demanded by cross-build equivalence.

execute.doc: Execute one expression-family opcode against state. Returns Continue on success. Halts only on: unknown collation (OpcodeIllegal); unreachable structural bounds violations (OpcodeIllegal). Arithmetic overflow on Add/Subtract/Multiply promotes to Real rather than halting (SQLite semantics).
